name: menu-controller-unification
title: refactor(ui): unify ContextMenu and MenuPopup into one menu controller (keyboard-nav parity)
description: Follow-up to 08-23-struct-context-menu-focus-dismiss. Two parallel menu implementations: ContextMenu (hex grid, contextMenu.ts: full render + keyboard nav + dismissal) and wireMenuPopup (sidebar popovers: struct field menu, integrity profile menu; open/close + dismissal only, no nav). Merge into one MenuController with options {renderer|itemHTML, focusFirst, ariaButton, openTrigger}. Generic Arrow/Enter/Home/End nav over configured item selector (.ctx-row, .integrity-profile-menu-item). Touches hexViewer.ts + contextMenu.test.ts (221 lines) + menuPopup.test.ts. Kills divergence class where #196 fixed hex grid only.
creator: deviousprophet
